node.statement: Let Phi_n:B(A)->B(M_n tensor A) be entrywise amplification, Phi_n(T)([X_ij])=[T(X_ij)]. It is linear and unital, and direct entrywise evaluation gives Phi_n(ST)=Phi_n(S)Phi_n(T). It is bounded: writing E_ij:M_n tensor A->A for coordinate extraction and J_ij:A->M_n tensor A for insertion in the (i,j) entry, Phi_n(T)=sum_{i,j} J_ij T E_ij; these finitely many coordinate maps are bounded for the operator-space matrix norm, so ||Phi_n(T)||<=C_n||T|| for a finite C_n. Therefore Phi_n preserves norm limits.
